BackstoryDef.title: community mechanic
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was born into a fledgling drone community. From a young age, [PAWN_pronoun] was fascinated by the inner workings of the bunker's machinery. [PAWN_pronoun] spent [PAWN_possessive] youth tinkering with broken-down doors, jury-rigging power conduits, and keeping the settlement's vital life support systems from failing. This hands-on experience made [PAWN_nameDef] an indispensable member of the community, known for being able to fix almost anything with a bit of scrap and a lot of ingenuity.

BackstoryDef.title: door technician
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] developed a fascination with the machinery that kept the community sealed and functional. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to restore failing servos, calibrate sensors, and rebuild mechanisms from scrap. Whenever a door jammed or a gate froze in place, [PAWN_pronoun] was the one called to fix it — usually with a few clever shortcuts no one else understood.

BackstoryDef.title: repair doctor
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: When a fellow drone suffered damage, whether from an accident or a system malfunction, [PAWN_nameDef] was the one to patch them up. [PAWN_pronoun] learned to replace damaged plating, recalibrate fried circuits, and perform delicate repairs on sensitive actuators. This work gave [PAWN_nameDef] a deep understanding of drone anatomy and a steady hand.

BackstoryDef.title: community nurse
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was assigned to assist damaged drones after accidents or malfunctions. [PAWN_pronoun] handled routine patch‑ups, replaced minor plating, and kept circuits stable until more skilled technicians arrived. Known for patience and reliability, [PAWN_nameDef] helped ensure the community’s drones could return to duty without falling apart.

BackstoryDef.title: community miner
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] was assigned to the deepest shafts of the community, tasked with extracting vital ores and minerals from the rock. Day after day, [PAWN_pronoun] operated heavy drills and laser cutters, carving out new tunnels and hauling back cartloads of raw materials. The constant vibration and dust were harsh, but [PAWN_nameDef] found satisfaction in knowing that [PAWN_possessive] labor provided the very foundation upon which the community was built.

BackstoryDef.title: structure keeper
BackstoryDef.baseDesc: [PAWN_nameDef] grew up repairing walls, sealing cracks, and reinforcing beams in the abandoned facility the community called home. [PAWN_pronoun] learned construction through necessity, ensuring that shelters stayed upright and corridors didn’t collapse. Quietly dependable, [PAWN_nameDef] became known as the drone who kept the settlement standing.
